name: FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief
problem: A buyer has a bounded agriculture, land, water, production, resilience, or food-infrastructure question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation that separates what is known, challenged, missing, and required next.
use_when: research this land or water question
give me an evidence brief on this region
stress test this food production thesis
tell me what evidence is missing before we build
inputs: Defined question, buyer email and selected fixed offer. Geography, site candidates, asset type, crop, water source, thesis assumptions and authorized evidence may be supplied as scope context.
outputs: A bounded Sense-Challenge-Decide evidence packet with findings, source references, evidence-state labels, coverage gaps, adversarial challenge, evidence-acquisition queue, thesis-memory requirements and human-review items.
pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.
confirmation: Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout. Verified payment queues a human-controlled mission; consequential claims or actions remain review-gated.
invocation_status: LIVE OWNED FABRIC VERIFIED: FAIE human UI, ephemeral public investigation/comparison API, and native read-only specialist MCP are externally verified at fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com. legacy provider transport is disabled. Paid work remains human-confirmed and consequential decisions remain review-gated.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
